title: How Scientific Disagreement Is Communicated · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short article (150–200 words) for a school magazine about a disagreement between two students. Explain how they communicated and what they learned. Use passive voice, sequence words, and linking words.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
